newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Bancorp postpones annual meeting.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Bancorp postpones annual meeting.

text.p: U.S. Bancorp Monday said it postponed the annual meeting of shareholders scheduled for April 15.
In a statement, the bank said the move follows U.S. Bancorp's agreement to be acquired by First Bank System Inc.

In the near future, U.S. Bancorp said it will be filing proxy materials describing the proposed acquisition by First Bank System with the Securities and Exchange Commission. When the proxy materials describing the proposed acquisition are available for mailing, a new notice will be mailed to shareholders stating the date, time, and place of the postponed annual meeting.
